title: Restore bounded APPID_CONTROL reads for historical LibreCAD ENC fixtures

sourceProfile.historicalWriter: LibreCAD bundled libdxfrw ENC writer; see docs/research/p4-libreCAD-historical-control-read-profile-2026-11-05.json
sourceProfile.frameGuard: Only APPID_CONTROL type at root handle 0x09, AC1021 or AC1027, empty reactors/EED/XDictionary/data-storage prefix, and exact version-specific object-size/body-stream relation enter the historical bounded BitShort count path. Existing count limits, frame bounds, handle decoding and uniqueness checks remain active.

formatBasis.reference: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.65 (APPID_CONTROL)
formatBasis.legacyReadPolicy: The historical source fixtures are tolerated with the prior bounded BitShort interpretation only for the exact profile above; this is not normative conformance or writer qualification.

observations.AC1021: The tracked historical fixture produces no APPID_CONTROL unclaimed-data diagnostic. Generated inline controls separately verify the parser's exact tail-bit accounting and retry behavior.
observations.AC1027: The bounded reader preserves the historical import and records 173 unclaimed object-data bits as TableControlUnclaimedData severity Error. Strict output remains refused for this source disposition.
observations.fixturePolicy: No DWG or DXF fixture was added or modified.

validation.result: PASS: 2/2 tests; fixture regression 0.21 s and reader matrix 0.67 s.

PASS: generated AC1021/AC1027 historical APPID_CONTROL controls cover accepted bounded frames, exact tail-bit accounting, truncation reset and corrected retry; an AC1027 five-bit suffix remains observable.

validation.result: FAIL on Linux and Windows: the 7-test selector passed 6/7 because a valid generated AC1027 29-bit absent-string footer was misclassified as unclaimed APPID_CONTROL data. This failure triggered the local fix above; no source fixtures were added.

implementation.behavior: Use the normal boundary-checked AC1027 APPID_CONTROL count and valid absent-string footer first. Only when that exact interpretation fails, admit the narrow historical BS profile and report unclaimed object-data bits as an integrity error; the historical AC1027 173-bit suffix remains strict-output-blocking.
